mapper.update: INSERT INTO job_run(id, tenant_id, job_type, batch_key, status, max_attempts, available_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{p.id}, #{p.tenantId}, #{p.type}, #{p.batchKey}, 'PENDING', #{p.maxAttempts}, #{p.availableAt}, #{p.now}, #{p.now}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM job_run WHERE job_type=#{p.type} AND tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{p.tenantId} AND batch_key=#{p.batchKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE job_run SET lease_expires_at=#{p.until}, updated_at=#{p.now} WHERE id=#{p.id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{p.owner}
mapper.select: SELECT cancel_requested FROM job_run WHERE id=#{p.id} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_owner=#{p.owner}
SELECT * FROM job_run WHERE status='RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at <= #{p.now} ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT 100
SELECT status FROM job_run WHERE id=#{p.id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE job_run SET status='CANCELLED', started_at=#{p.now}, finished_at=#{p.now}, updated_at=#{p.now} WHERE id=#{p.id}
UPDATE job_run SET cancel_requested=true, updated_at=#{p.now} WHERE id=#{p.id}
